Witness explicitly notes brake/gear function not demonstrated in the photo.
Photo shows dirt/rust spots on frame and a worn seat, inconsistent with a 6-month-old bike.

risks.risk: Brake and gear mechanisms may not function despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Short video clip showing brake lever squeeze and gear shift through all positions
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / needing full brake-gear service

risks.risk: Rust or frame damage beyond what's visible in the rotated single photo
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, underside, and fork from multiple angles

risks.risk: Wheels may be out of true or tires worn beyond safe use
risks.proof: Video of each wheel spinning freely, plus close-up of tread
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing wheel truing and tire replacement

risks.risk: Frame size unknown, may not fit buyer
risks.proof: Photo with tape measure on seat tube or standover height

risks.risk: Actual age far older than claimed 6 months
risks.proof: Original purchase receipt or dated photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as an older, well-used bicycle, not near-new

proof_requests: Video of brakes being squeezed and gears shifting through full range
Close-up photos of frame tubing, fork, and underside for rust/damage
Video of both wheels spinning to check for wobble
Close-up of tire tread and sidewalls
Photo of frame size sticker or measurement with tape
Any purchase receipt or proof of purchase date
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a used bicycle, but photo evidence contradicts the 'new/no rust' claims and cannot confirm brake/gear function, so it must be priced at worst case (older, worn, unverified mechanicals) pending proof.
